gloss: to split in two; to divide in half

definitions.gloss: to split in two; to divide in half; to break into two pieces
definitions.explanation: To divide one object into two parts, either physically (breaking, cutting) or figuratively (splitting a group, opinion, or share).

examples.japanese: ⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}った。
examples.english: I split the cake in two.

examples.japanese: リンゴ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}って⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}けた→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: I split the apple in two and shared it with my younger brother.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧になっている。
examples.english: This issue has become a major debate that has split public opinion in two.

notes:
Productive pattern with {数詞|すうし} + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ ("split into N parts"). The figurative use, especially ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る or ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る, is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧／⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る: to split a cake/bread in two
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る: to split opinion in two
- ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る: to divide public opinion
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る: to split a team into two groups

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to halve — focus on the result (each half equal)
- ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to divide in two — softer, may use non-physical division (sorting)
- ⟦{二分|にぶん}→二分：30504_nibun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bisect; to split in two — more formal/written

COMMON PATTERNS:
The pattern extends to other numbers: ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ (split in three), ⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ (split in four), etc.
